summary: Grupo TMM, S.A.B. (BMV: TMM A; OTC: GTMAY), a Mexican maritime transportation and logistics company, furnished a Form 6-K — the US-equivalent foreign issuer current report — attaching its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release dated October 30, 2026. Results show consolidated revenue of Ps.272.7 million, operating income of Ps.27.8 million, and a quarterly net loss of Ps.27.9 million driven by FX and financing costs, with nine-month cumulative net income of Ps.8.3 million. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed; this is a routine earnings filing, not a special situation.
